Short Information

UP SWD Social Welfare Department, Uttar Pradesh  has released the notification of Post Matric Scholarship 2026-2027 in Uttar Pradesh. Candidates who want to participate in this post matric scholarship of Uttar Pradesh government can apply online from 22 July 2026 till the last date. Apart from Uttar Pradesh, candidates from other states who have taken admission in any college of Uttar Pradesh can also apply.   • Complete Form Last Date : 21/09/2026

  • Correction Date : As Per Schedule

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : 0/- 
  • SC / ST / PH : 0/-
  • Female All Category : 0/-
  • No Application Fee for the All Candidates Only Fill Online Form.

UP Scholarship Eligibility 2026-2027

  • Uttar Pradesh Enrolled with School, College, Institution or University
  • Post Matric 11 : Passed Class 10 Exam and Enrolled in Class 11
  • Post Matric 12 : Passed Class 11 Exam and Enrolled in Class 12
  • Dashmottar : Under Graduate / Post Graduate / Certificate / Diploma Courses.

 

UP Scholarship Document Required Fresh Candidates

  • Last Qualifying Exam Mark Sheet
  • Cast Certificate
  • Income Certificate
  • Bank Passbook
  • Fee Receipt Number
  • Annual Non Refundable Amount
  • Enrollment Number
  • Aadhar Card Number
  • Latest Passport Size Scan Photo
  • For Renewal Candidates : Kindly Use Last Year Registration Number to Login to Renewal Section and Enter the Fresh Details
  • UP SWD Social Welfare Department, Uttar Pradesh  has released the notification of Post Matric Scholarship 2026-2027 in Uttar Pradesh. Notification and Invited Online Application Form for the UP SWD Social Welfare Department, Uttar Pradesh Application 2026 Candidate Can Apply Online.

  • UP Scholarship 2026-2027 Fresh Candidates : Whoever is a new candidate who has taken admission this year should be in class 11, 12 (High School / Intermediate)  2026-2027 & Other Dashmottar Courses UG / PG / Diploma / Certificates course, should apply in fresh.
  • UP Scholarship 2026-2027 Renewal Candidates : Candidates who are already enrolled in any school / college and had applied for scholarships last year will renew their application.
  • Kindly Collect the All Document Before Apply Online.
  • If you are not now of the non refundable Amount, please check your fees receipt OR contact the college / school if there is any confusion.
